title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: This PR adds a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and accompanying quickstarts plus the necessary docs site updates. Motivation: make it straightforward for developers to get started with RAG + agent workflows using Redwood's runtime and examples, reduce onboarding friction, and provide canonical templates for common patterns (search+answer, multi-tool walk-throughs, and structured output). The change includes: 1) new example templates under redwood-examples/rag-agents including Python and TypeScript samples demonstrating retrieval, tool calling, and simple memory handling; 2) quickstart walkthroughs in docs/site/content/quickstarts that map the examples to step-by-step instructions and minimal config files; 3) agent template library under docs/site/content/agents/templates with concise YAML/JSON templates for common agent patterns; 4) sample workflows for tool authorization and sandboxed tool mocks used in CI; 5) minor API docs clarifications and a short migration note for teams upgrading from the legacy rag-examples. Checklist: - [x] Add example code and tests - [x] Docs quickstarts and templates added - [x] CI examples run in ephemeral sandbox - [x] Review and accessibility sweep - [x] Final doc site build and link checks Notes: kept examples intentionally small and focused, linked to the existing RAG evaluation harness for reproducible prompts and added a single tutorial video link. See commits and changed files for details.
